errors.evidence: This description oversimplifies the trend from 2008 to 2010. The line shows a very sharp drop from 2008 to 2009, followed by a smaller drop from 2009 to 2010. The description treats this two-year period as a single 'sharp drop' ending in 2010, which misrepresents the shape of the line.
The value for the year 2010 is visually just below the 1.00% grid line (approximately 0.9%). Stating it is 'around 1.00%' is a minor inaccuracy.
